mutants.name: fixed_unchecked
mutants.desc: profile DP that skips adjacency checks when the current cell is fixed (assumes given digits are consistent)

mutants.name: left_wraps
mutants.desc: profile DP using st[j-1] as left neighbour even at j == 0 (wraps to the last column of the row above)

mutants.name: no_question_returns_one
mutants.desc: special-cases a grid with no '?' as 1 way without checking the fixed digits are valid

mutants.name: row_independent
mutants.desc: counts each row independently (horizontal constraints only) and multiplies, ignoring vertical adjacency
